title: HW↔ML-001: Sensor Characterization Data + ML Data Spec
description: ML provides the sensor data requirements specification (sampling rate, resolution, dynamic range, SNR target); HW provides measured sensor characterization data and the joint conformance loop. Grounded in HARDWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3 and EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.5 (Sensor Data Fidelity Feedback Loop).

ml_data_spec.description: ML→HW: required sensor data specification for model quality.

characterization_data.description: HW→ML: measured sensor characterization report (delivered within 5 business days of characterization completion).

measured_drift.description: Measured sensor drift (with unit stated in the report).

conformance_assessment.description: ML→HW: conformance verdict within 10 business days.

verdict.description: CONFIRMED = all specs met; CONDITIONAL = met with noted limitations; REJECTED = not met.

limitations.description: Required (non-empty) when verdict = CONDITIONAL; documents expected impact on model accuracy.

remediation_plan.description: Required when verdict = REJECTED (sensor replacement, AFE redesign, or ML spec relaxation).

x-macp.tier_rationale: CONDITIONAL acceptance escalates to a joint Architect trade-off decision (Tier-2); REJECTED triggers a hardware/spec remediation plan. In-range sensor drift is the keystone FMEA chain FC-001.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (data-spec handoff at planning; characterization review in execution; data-fidelity sign-off before production); SLA_FROM_EVENT (HW delivers report within 5 business days; ML assesses within 10)
confirm_conditions: characterization_data meets every ml_data_spec threshold (SNR, resolution, dynamic range)
all quantities carry units (Hz, bits, dB, µs)
reject_conditions: measured SNR/resolution below spec presented as CONFIRMED
drift characterization omitted (blocks FC-001 detection assessment)
counter_conditions: specs met with limitations (CONDITIONAL) — escalate to Architect trade-off within 5 business days, do not auto-confirm
hardware reworked since characterization — request re-characterization (loop step 1)
